preconditions.expression: all(c in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} for c in stdin.splitlines()[0])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is string P consisting only of lowercase letters 'c', 'h', 'e', and 'f'.
The second line of stdin is an integer Q (1 ≤ Q ≤ 10^6) representing the number of queries.
Each of the next Q lines contains exactly four space-separated values: characters a and b, and integers L and R.

preconditions.expression: all(a in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} and b in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} and a != b for query in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+Q] for a, b, _, _ in [query.split()])
preconditions.description: For each query, a and b are distinct lowercase letters from {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'}.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= len(P) for P in [stdin.splitlines()[0]] for query in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+Q] for _, _, L, R in [query.split()])
preconditions.description: For each query, 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ |P|, where |P| is the length of string P.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(count_good_substrings(P, a, b, L, R)) for P in [stdin.splitlines()[0]] for query in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+Q] for a, b, L, R in [query.split()]) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each query (a, b, L, R), stdout contains the count of good substrings starting with a and ending with b, where the substring starts at index S_i (1-based) and ends at index E_i (1-based) such that L ≤ S_i < E_i ≤ R. A substring is good if its first and last characters are different (a != b).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count_good_substrings(P, a, b, L, R) <= (R - L + 1) * (R - L) // 2 for P in [stdin.splitlines()[0]] for query in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+Q] for a, b, L, R in [query.split()])
postconditions.description: The count of good substrings for each query is a non-negative integer bounded by the maximum possible substrings in the range [L, R].
